storyline.real: Hamilton leads until a late safety car; Verstappen pits for soft tyres, passes him on the final lap and takes the race and the title.
storyline.headline: Hamilton holds on in Abu Dhabi for an eighth title

mastery.label: Beat Verstappen with one more stop

eras.briefing: Abu Dhabi, 2021. The final race, and Verstappen and Hamilton arrive level on 369.5 points. Verstappen starts from pole, Hamilton beside him. You run Hamilton, 5.5 s clear of Verstappen after 34 laps. Finish ahead of him and the title is yours.
